descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
The dream drive, from the driver's seat - in Malibu.

THE CAR
A V12 sports car with a race cockpit: a racing wheel, bucket seats, a roll cage, shift lights across the dash and a live display behind the wheel. Grip the wheel, work the gear stick and pull the handbrake with your own hands - or drive with the joysticks.

A REAL 6-SPEED MANUAL
Move the stick through a real H-pattern: 1 3 5 up top, 2 4 6 underneath, reverse far right. Rev it to the shift lights and snap the next gear in. Prefer to cruise? Switch to automatic.

50 MILES OF CALIFORNIA
The Pacific Coast Highway past Malibu and the Santa Monica Pier, the tunnel onto the 10, the 405 over the Sepulveda Pass past the Getty, the 101 through the Valley, then Malibu Canyon down to the ocean.

ROAD EVENTS
Seven events on real roads, from the PCH Sunset Sprint to The Full Loop. Quick-travel to the start line, watch the lights count you down and race for gold. Your best run comes back as a ghost car to beat.

SPEED TRAPS AND RUSH HOUR
Six speed cameras record your top speed. In Rush Hour, thread through heavy traffic - close passes build your combo, a crash loses it.

SUNSET, DAY AND NIGHT
Golden hour over the Pacific, bright California sun, or the city lit up after dark.

MALIBU FM
An original soundtrack on the car radio.

Plus paint colours, interior trims, twenty achievements, career ranks and a map with quick travel.
